_docs: Per-faction UI theme colors (editable — served no-cache, just edit and reload the page). Keys are the MAIN faction names (Dwarves, Demons, Twigs, Miaous, Orcs, Mummies — the values of the `faction` column / the `FACTIONS` table in cards.mjs). Fields per faction: accent = primary UI color (buttons, outlines, highlights, glow); accent2 = secondary color (turn number, counters, modal headings, hover rings); onAccent = text color drawn ON TOP of accent-colored buttons. Colors are sampled from the faction logo (assets/logo_<key>.png). A faction missing here falls back to the default teal/orange palette. The page BACKGROUND is intentionally NOT themed (it stays the dark blue of style.css :root).
